approaches.name: Recursive depth-first search
approaches.intuition: From each unvisited land cell, recurse into every land neighbour. It is short but deep grids can overflow the call stack.
steps: On new land, count one and recurse into neighbours
approaches.space: O(rows * cols) for the visited grid and recursion

approaches.name: Iterative flood fill with an explicit stack
approaches.intuition: The same exploration without recursion, so a 1000 x 1000 grid cannot overflow the call stack.
steps: Flood the island with a stack, marking cells when pushed
pitfalls: Marking a cell when it is popped instead of pushed can push it many times.
Grid rows are strings: compare characters, not integers.

talkTrackMd: Treat the grid as a graph, say a flood fill labels one connected component, and count components. Mention BFS and DFS are equivalent here and why you avoided recursion.
